entities.summary: The forum of caesar, also known by the latin forum iulium or forum julium, forum caesaris, was a forum built by julius caesar near the forum romanum in rome in 46 bc. 45 BCE. Forum of Caesar is a archaeological site from Europe, created circa 45 BCE. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
